Name: PrintRightScript

<![CDATA[
function report$PrintRight$GridInit(g, r) {
  if (!r || !g._toolbar) return;
  var hiddenForms = null, toolbarIndex = -1;
  for (var i = 0; i < g._toolbar.length; i++) {
    if (g._toolbar[i][0] == 'Print') {
      toolbarIndex = i;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (toolbarIndex == -1) return;

  var targets, toolbarForm = g._toolbar[toolbarIndex][2], formIndex = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < toolbarForm.length; i++) {
    if (toolbarForm[i].Target) {
      targets = toolbarForm[i].Target.split(',');
      if (targets.length > 1 && Array.contains(r, targets[1])) formIndex.unshift(i);
    } else if (toolbarForm[i].MenuItems) {
      var subToolbar = toolbarForm[i].MenuItems;
      for (var j = 0; j < subToolbar.length; j++) {
        targets = subToolbar[j].Target.split(',');
        if (targets.length > 1 && Array.contains(r, targets[1])) formIndex.unshift(parseFloat(i + '.' + j));
      }
    }
  }

  if (formIndex.length > 0) {
    var o = {Form: formIndex, Value: 1};
    if (g._disableForms) g._disableForms.unshift(o);
    else g._disableForms = [o];
  }
}
]]>

Name: QueryScript

function create$Query$Extender(g) {
  if (g._queryControl) {
    var panel = g._queryControl._viewPanel;
    if (panel && panel._horizontalDivider && (panel._horizontalDivider.style.top.replace('px', '') != panel._panelFixHeight)) {
      show$QueryExtender(g);
      return;
    }
  }

  var gridContainer = $get('queryInitGrid');
  var gridTag = 'MainReport';
  var id = g._id.replace(gridTag, g._controller)
  g._queryID = id;

  var q = $create(FastBusiness.QueryExtender, {
    id: id,
    controller: ']]>&QueryID;<![CDATA[',
    language: g._language,
    gridID: gridTag,
    servicePath: '../AppService/FastBusiness.QueryExtenderService.asmx',
    getViewPageMethod: 'GetQueryViewPage',
    handlerPath: '../AppHandler/Query.ashx',
    singlePage: '0',
    force: 1
  }, null, null, gridContainer);
  g._queryControl = q;
  show$QueryExtender(g);
}
function show$QueryExtender(g) {
  g._element.style.display = 'none';
  g._queryControl._element.style.display='block';
}
]]>

Name: VisibleFieldScript
Content:
<![CDATA[
function showing$VisibleField$Grid(g, d, k) {
  if (!d) return;
  g._visibleField$Data = d;
  var r = d[k];
  if (!r) return;
  var c = r.replace(/ /g, '').split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < c.length; i++) {
    var l = g._getColumnOrder(c[i]);
    if (l >= 0) {
      var field = g._fields[l - 1];
      field.Visible = false;
      field.Hidden = true;
    }
  }
}
function init$VisibleField$Form(f, k) {
  var g = f.grid, d = g._visibleField$Data;
  if (!d) return;
  var r = d[k];
  if (!r) return;
  var c = r.replace(/ /g, '').split(',');
  f._visibleField = c;
  var fields = g._dirInfor.Fields;
  for (var i = 0; i < c.length; i++) {
    var field = $func.findField(c[i], fields);
    if (field && field.AllowNulls) {
      field.ClientScript = 'style="visibility:hidden;"';
      field.FilterSource= 'Invariability';
      field.HeaderText = '';
      field.Label = '';
    }
  }
}
function load$VisibleField$Form(f) {
  if (f._visibleField) {
    for (var i = 0; i < f._visibleField.length; i++) {
      var o = f.getItem(f._visibleField[i]);
      if (o) o.parentElement.style.borderColor = 'transparent';
    }
  }
}
function showing$VisibleField$GridDetail(g, k) {
  var d = g.get_element().parentForm.grid._visibleField$Data;
  if (!d) return;
  var r = d[k];
  if (!r) return;
  var c = r.replace(/ /g,'').split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < c.length; i++) {
    var l = g._getColumnOrder(c[i]);
    if (l >= 0) {
      var field = g._fields[l - 1];
      if (field.AllowNulls) {
        field.Visible = false;
        field.Hidden = true;
        field.FilterSource= 'Invariability';
      }
    }
  }
}
]]>

Name: GNEditScript
Content:
<![CDATA[
/* <flatten type="Javascript"> */
function gn$Grid$ExecuteCommandEdit(g, e, f, c) {
  var k, column, r = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < c.length; i ++) {
    k = c[i];
    column = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(k[0]));
    if (column > 0) {
      if (g._getItemValue(g._activeRow, column) == k[1]) r++;
    }
  }
  
  if (r > 0) {
    if (!g._gn$SureEdit || g._gn$SureEdit == 0) {
      if (e) e.type.cancelEvent = true;
        else if (f) f._$handleStatus = [];
      g._gn$WaitSure = 0;
      gn$Grid$GotoEdit(g);
    } else {
      g._gn$SureEdit = 0;
    }
  }
}

function gn$Form$ExecuteCommandEdit(f, c) {
  if (f._action == 'View' || f._action == 'Edit') {
    var id = f.get_id(), btnEdit = f._findButton('Edit'), g = f.grid;
    if (!btnEdit) return;

    var k, r = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < c.length; i ++) {
      k = c[i];
      if (f.getItemValue($func.trim(k[0])) == k[1]) r++;
    }

    if (r > 0) {
      if (!btnEdit._defaultOnclick) btnEdit._defaultOnclick = btnEdit.getAttribute('onclick');
      btnEdit.setAttribute('onclick', String.format('return gn$Form$EditButtonClick(\'{0}\');', id));
    } else if (btnEdit._defaultOnclick) {
      btnEdit.setAttribute('onclick', btnEdit._defaultOnclick);
    }
  }
}
function gn$Grid$GotoEdit(g) {
  g._gn$SureEdit = 1;
  g.executeCommand({commandName:"Edit", commandArgument:"0"})
}
/* </flatten> */
function gn$Form$EditButtonClick(fid) {
  var f = $find(fid), k, r = 0;
  var c = []]>&APVEditArrayCheck;<![CDATA[].concat(]]>&EBankingEditArrayCheck;<![CDATA[);
  for (var i = 0; i < c.length; i ++) {
    k = c[i];
    if (f.getItemValue($func.trim(k[0])) == k[1]) r++;
  }

  if (r > 0) {
    f.executeDialog(1);
    f._findButton('Close').focus();
    return false;
  }
  f.executeDialog(1);
  return true;
}
]]>

Name: FlowMultiTagRowRequest
Content:
declare @s nvarchar(128), @l int, @size int, @i int, @delta int
select top 0 identity(int, 1, 1) as id, stt_rec, cast('' as char(3)) as stt_rec0, cast('' as char(6)) as p into #tagRow from 
select @size = 0
select @i = 1, @l = datalength(text) from @k
select @size = charindex(',', text, @size) from @k

while @size > 0 and @size < @l begin
  select @s = replace(substring(text, @i, @size - @i), '''', '') from @k
  insert into #tagRow(stt_rec, stt_rec0) select left(@s, charindex(char(255), @s) - 1), right(@s, (len(@s) - charindex(char(255), @s)))
  select @i = @size + 1, @delta = charindex(',', substring(text, @size + 1, @l - @size)) from @k
  if @delta = 0 break

  select @size = @size + @delta
end
if @i < @l begin
  select @s = replace(substring(text, @i, @l - @i), '''', '') from @k
  insert into #tagRow(stt_rec, stt_rec0) select left(@s, charindex(char(255), @s) - 1), right(@s, (len(@s) - charindex(char(255), @s)))
end
update #tagRow set p = convert(char(6), b.ngay_ct, 112) from #tagRow a join  b on b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec
